meta.title: 9 Unmissable Things to Do in Hoi An Vietnam 🇻🇳 2026
meta.description:
Hoi An is one of the most beautiful towns in Vietnam 🇻🇳
But with so many things to do, what are the experiences you absolutely shouldn’t miss?

In this video, I explore the 9 best things to do in Hoi An, from the famous lantern-lit Old Town to hidden spots, local food and unique cultural experiences.

Whether you're visiting Central Vietnam, planning a Vietnam itinerary, or just looking for the most memorable activities in Hoi An — this guide will help you make the most of your trip.

✨ In this video:

00:07 Introduction
00:44 Walking through the Hoi An Ancient Town
01:24 Boat ride on the Thu Bon River
01:55 Discover Local Markets and Handicrafts
02:33 Get Custom-Made Clothes
03:06 Join a Vietnamese Cooking Class
03:36 Visit the Rice Fields and Tra Que Village
04:04 Relax on Hoi An’s Beaches
04:30 Watch the ‘Hoi An Memories’ Show
05:02 Join a Lantern-Making Workshop
05:40 Nighlife (Bonus)

Hoi An is famous for its atmosphere, colorful lanterns and preserved architecture. It’s also one of the most charming towns in Southeast Asia.

📍 Location: Hoi An, Central Vietnam

Curious to hear your favorites! 👇

comments.author: @laurentmuller4465
comments.text: I visited Hoi An last year and the lanterns at night were definitely my favorite. The whole old town feels magical after sunset! The boat ride on the river was great too though.

comments.author: @NomadFlow.Traveltips
comments.text: Totally agree! The atmosphere after sunset is something special. The lanterns, the reflections on the river… it really feels magical. Glad you got to experience the boat ride too — it’s such a unique way to see the old town at night.
